item.description:
## Bug fixes
- **Draft-assisted replies no longer pile up memory, and run faster on long conversations.** While a draft-assisted (DFlash) model wrote a reply to a large conversation, the memory the Mac must keep in RAM could jump by several gigabytes mid-reply. Working buffers left over from each draft round are now handed back once they pass 2 GB. On the 35B draft-assisted model with a 34,000-token conversation, that memory peaked at 2 GB instead of 7.6 GB, and replies rose from 49.8 to about 60 tokens per second. - **Status updates during draft-assisted replies.** The memory figures on the status page now change while a draft-assisted model writes, instead of staying fixed for the whole reply.
## Compatibility
- No setting, command or local API changed. Replies from plain models are unchanged. - Conversations, downloaded models, the prompt store on disk and every setting are kept. - Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
## Distribution
The app and disk image are signed with the project's Developer ID, notarized and stapled by Apple, and the update is signed with the project's Sparkle key.
